records.title: Nexus: Native Mesh Generation with Diffusion
records.reason: The full text is a diffusion-based 3D mesh-generation method that replaces autoregressive mesh-token serialization with octree vertex and topology diffusion. Despite discussing faster mesh generation, this is not LLM/VLM inference or the linked language-model serving lineage.

records.title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
records.reason: The full text’s active GUI task-state memory helps long-horizon agent execution, but its experiments report task success, not reductions in inference tokens, calls, latency or memory. The paper mentions screenshot downsampling for lower visual-token/training cost, which is a data/training choice rather than the agent-memory method’s measured runtime benefit. Retain as borderline because agent memory could affect inference workload but the claimed connection is not established.

records.title: Orca: The World is in Your Mind
records.reason: arXiv abstract: Orca learns a multimodal world-state transition model; the contribution is a world-model learning paradigm, not LLM inference resource reduction.

records.title: PowerOPD: Stabilizing On-Policy Distillation with Bounded Power Transformation
records.reason: arXiv abstract: PowerOPD stabilizes on-policy distillation and gradient estimates during LLM post-training; it targets training stability/sample efficiency, not inference-time efficiency.

records.title: Retrospective Progress-Aware Self-Refinement for LLM Agent Training
records.reason: arXiv abstract: RePro adds retrospective progress supervision and rollouts for LLM-agent training; it improves training signals/task success rather than inference compute, memory or latency.
